verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Beamer can collect user comments, reactions, NPS responses and feedback. However, nothing documents a PM replying to a customer from within a feedback record. The only 'close the feedback loop' claim depends on integrations with third-party support apps, which is an adjacent workaround rather than a native in-record reply capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can reply to customers directly from within the feedback record to close the loop

citations.quote: Integrate with your favorite support apps to close the feedback loop.
